en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The most trouble-maker of the people to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, is the one who killed someone other than his (attempted) killer, and the one who struck someone who did not strike him’.
